mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TC_BUSINESS_RULE ( ID, RULE_CODE, RULE_NAME, RULE_TYPE, RULE_CATEGORY, BUSINESS_DOMAIN, RULE_DESC, RULE_EXPRESSION, RULE_SYNTAX, EXECUTION_ORDER, IS_ACTIVE, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPIRE_DATE, STATUS, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, VERSION_NO ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.ruleCode}, #{item.ruleName}, #{item.ruleType}, #{item.ruleCategory}, #{item.businessDomain}, #{item.ruleDesc}, #{item.ruleExpression}, #{item.ruleSyntax}, #{item.executionOrder}, #{item.isActive}, #{item.effectiveDate}, #{item.expireDate}, #{item.status}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.createUser}, #{item.updateUser}, #{item.versionNo} )

update.foreach: UPDATE TC_BUSINESS_RULE SET RULE_NAME = #{item.ruleName}, RULE_TYPE = #{item.ruleType}, RULE_CATEGORY = #{item.ruleCategory}, BUSINESS_DOMAIN = #{item.businessDomain}, RULE_DESC = #{item.ruleDesc}, RULE_EXPRESSION = #{item.ruleExpression}, RULE_SYNTAX = #{item.ruleSyntax}, EXECUTION_ORDER = #{item.executionOrder}, IS_ACTIVE = #{item.isActive}, EFFECTIVE_DATE = #{item.effectiveDate}, EXPIRE_DATE = #{item.expireDate}, STATUS = #{item.status}, REMARK = #{item.remark}, UPDATE_TIME = #{item.updateTime}, UPDATE_USER = #{item.updateUser}, VERSION_NO = #{item.versionNo} WHERE ID = #{item.id}

mapper.update: UPDATE TC_BUSINESS_RULE SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE TC_BUSINESS_RULE SET IS_ACTIVE = #{isActive}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRules, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_ACTIVE = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activeRules, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledRules, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as testingRules, TO_CHAR(MAX(UPDATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as lastUpdateTime FROM TC_BUSINESS_RULE

FROM TC_BUSINESS_RULE WHERE IS_ACTIVE = '1' AND STATUS = '1' AND EXPIRE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRE_DATE BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + #{days} ORDER BY EXPIRE_DATE ASC
